requirement: Update a pathogen: load the live record, map the new name, description, and atypical flag onto it, save it, and report Updated; an unknown id is reported as not found.

preconditions.text: A live pathogen exists for the target id
The target id matches no live pathogen

inputs.text: Rename to 'Streptococcus pneumoniae' with a new description and atypical flag true
Rename to 'Haemophilus influenzae' with a new description and atypical flag false
Update request with an unknown pathogen id

returns.text: Success with Updated status; the new fields are persisted
The atypical flag follows the command
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Pathogen ID not found' error

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing pathogen is returned as a failed Result
